newsitem.title: USA: William Greenberg settles with ex-employees.
newsitem.headline: William Greenberg settles with ex-employees.

text.p: William Greenberg Jr Desserts and Cafes Inc said Wednesday that it concluded an agreement with some former employees who were terminated.
Chief executive Philip Grabow said in a statement, "We have amicably concluded our settlement with the company's former officers and employees who were terminated on April 1."
The cost of the settlement was not disclosed.
In other news, the company has decided to hold on to its William Greenberg Jr subsidiary and return it to profitability before contemplating any future spin-off or sale.
Grabow also said that talks are continuing to acquire Chatterly Elegant Desserts Inc, a baked products maker with $2.8 million in revenues in 1996.
The company also said that it will change its name to Creative Bakeries Inc, pending shareholder approval at its annual meeting, July 21.
